title: Hazaaron Zubane
artist: Amit Kamble, Prakruthi Angelina & Hemant Sharma

hinglish.verse12:
Saari srishti par, tera adhikaar
Tu raajadhiraaj hai Prabhu
Tujhse hai zameen, tujhse aasman
Jag ka tu maalik Prabhu
hinglish.pre_chorus:
Karte hain sajda,
Ibaadat ho teri sada
hinglish.chorus2:
Hazaroon zubaanen gaayen
Tera hi naam dohraayen
Yeshu tu pavitra hai
hinglish.verse2:
Oonch-neech ka, na koi wajood
Tere raajy mein, tere raajy mein
Har kisi ka hai, swagat yahan
Tere raajy mein, tere raajy mein
hinglish.pre_chorus2:
Teri rahmat mein hi,
Tu leta hai sabko kareeb ...
hinglish.chorus3:
Hazaroon zubaanen gaayen
Tera hi naam dohraayen
Yeshu tu pavitra hai
hinglish.bridge:
Shahon ka shaah hai tu Khuda
Tera na koi muqaabla
Tera hi takht rahe,
Sabse ooncha ........
hinglish.chorus4:
Hazaroon zubaanen gaayen
Tera hi naam dohraayen
Yeshu tu pavitra hai
hinglish.verse13:
Over all creation, Your authority reigns
You are the King of kings, O Lord
From You is the earth, from You the skies
You are the Master of the world, O Lord
hinglish.pre_chorus3:
We bow down before You,
May worship be Yours forever
hinglish.chorus5:
Thousands of tongues sing
They repeat only Your name
Jesus, You are Holy
hinglish.verse22:
There is no status high or low
In Your Kingdom, in Your Kingdom
Everyone is welcomed here
In Your Kingdom, in Your Kingdom
hinglish.pre_chorus4:
Through Your mercy alone,
You draw everyone near...
hinglish.chorus6:
Thousands of tongues sing
They repeat only Your name
Jesus, You are Holy
hinglish.bridge2:
You are the King of all kings, O God
None can compare with You
Let Your throne remain
Highest of all...

hindi.verse1:
NA DAROONGA ( मैं न डरूंगा )
Changa ( तू चंगा करता है )
Magan ( मगन मगन तेरे प्यार मे )
Zindagi Ke Safar Mey ( ज़िंदगी के सफर )
Pyaare Pita ( प्यारे पिता )

seo_description: Hazaaron Zubane lyrics in Hindi and Hinglish by Amit Kamble, Prakruthi Angelina & Hemant Sharma - Nations of Worship 2024
